description: Searches published padel-racket records by model or brand words, exact year, shape, explicit budget currency and calculated playing characteristics. Returns a bounded list, applied ranking rule, missing inputs, dated source prices and canonical PadelTrue model URLs. All query words must match. A price filter requires an explicit three-letter currency; no currency conversion is applied. Ratings are calculated estimates, not play tests. Source prices do not establish current stock, delivery or medical suitability.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code explicitly established by the user, for example EUR or USD. Required with maxPrice. No conversion is applied; a dollar sign alone does not identify a currency.

query.description: Optional words from a brand or model name, for example nox at10. Leave absent for a budget/style search without a named model. Express price, year and rating constraints with their structured fields.

sort.description: Calculated rating used to order results; without it, results are in name order, not a best-match ranking.

name: search_rackets
title: Search the PadelTrue catalogue
